title: Intro to Godot
line: Build a small 2D coin game with scenes, nodes and GDScript.

project.title: A key and door room
project.brief: Make a one-room game alone. The player picks up a key that removes a locked door, walks to the exit and a Label says the room is cleared. Export it for Mac.
checks: The player is a CharacterBody2D whose script calls move_and_slide
A signal from an Area2D key frees a StaticBody2D door
A Label changes when the player reaches the exit

lessons.title: Make a project and a first scene
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner Godot 4. Make a new project, tour the Scene, FileSystem and Inspector docks, add a Node2D root named Main, save it as main.tscn and set it as the main scene.
lessons.passes: main.tscn has a Node2D root named Main and is the project's main scene.

lessons.title: Nodes and the scene tree
lessons.goal: Teach Godot nodes and parent and child trees by adding a Sprite2D under Main that shows icon.svg, moving it to 200, 150 in the Inspector and running the project.
lessons.passes: Main has a Sprite2D child with icon.svg as its texture at position 200, 150.

lessons.title: Your first GDScript
lessons.goal: Teach GDScript in Godot 4 by attaching a script to the Sprite2D that prints a line in _ready and spins the sprite in _process using delta and an exported speed variable.
lessons.passes: The script prints in _ready and changes rotation in _process using delta.

lessons.title: A player that moves
lessons.goal: Teach player movement in Godot 4. Build player.tscn from a CharacterBody2D, a Sprite2D and a CollisionShape2D, then read Input.get_vector, set velocity and call move_and_slide.
lessons.passes: player.tscn has a CharacterBody2D root and its script calls move_and_slide.

lessons.title: Put the player in a walled room
lessons.goal: Teach instancing scenes and static collisions in Godot 4 by adding player.tscn to Main and boxing it in with four StaticBody2D walls that each have a CollisionShape2D.
lessons.passes: Main holds one player.tscn instance and four StaticBody2D walls with shapes.

lessons.title: A coin and the body_entered signal
lessons.goal: Teach Godot signals by building coin.tscn from an Area2D, connecting its body_entered signal to its own script and calling queue_free when the player touches the coin.
lessons.passes: coin.tscn has an Area2D root and its body_entered handler calls queue_free.

lessons.title: Count coins with your own signal
lessons.goal: Teach custom signals in GDScript by declaring a collected signal in the coin, emitting it on pickup and connecting five coin instances to one function in Main that adds to a score.
lessons.passes: The coin emits collected and five coins in Main are connected to one function.

lessons.title: Show the score in a Label
lessons.goal: Teach Godot UI nodes by adding a CanvasLayer with a Label to Main and setting its text to the word Coins and the score each time a coin is collected.
lessons.passes: A Label under a CanvasLayer shows the score and Main sets its text on pickup.

lessons.title: A countdown with a Timer node
lessons.goal: Teach the Godot Timer node and its timeout signal by giving the coin game a 30 second countdown, shown in a second Label, that stops the game when it reaches zero.
lessons.passes: A Timer's timeout signal lowers a countdown shown in a second Label.

lessons.title: Export the game for Mac
lessons.goal: Teach exporting from Godot 4. Download the export templates, add a macOS preset in the Export window, set a bundle identifier and export the coin game as an app you can open.
lessons.passes: A macOS export of the coin game is saved on disk.
